scope: one decoder layer per HF layer kind on a 1x1 Blackhole mesh (one chip of a p300c board)
_flat_keys_note: target_context and current_supported_context repeat hf_advertised_context.value and supported_context.value as plain integers, which is the shape .agents/scripts/check_context_contract.py reads.

hf_advertised_context.note: rope_parameters.rope_type is 'default' (theta 1e7); there is no YaRN/NTK scaling factor to reinterpret, so the advertised context is the raw max_position_embeddings.

supported_context.note: FunctionalDecoder.from_state_dict defaults max_seq_len to hf_config.max_position_embeddings and sizes the paged KV cache from the *padded* context; prefill_forward accepts any 1 <= seq_len <= max_seq_len with no divisibility requirement. Both layer kinds pass the PCC >= 0.995 bar at the full context in prefill, in the on-device cache/state, and in decode at the last addressable position.

largest_context_tested.note: prompt 262143 + one decoded token occupy exactly the advertised 262144 positions, so decode runs at the last addressable position; 262143 is divisible by none of the tile (32), page (64), SDPA chunk (256) or prefill chunk (2048)
largest_context_tested.evidence_method: A whole-prompt HF forward is impossible at this length, so the reference is built the only way that stays O(seq_len): linear_attention runs the HF layer in 16384-token segments with a carried DynamicCache (Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet continues exactly from a populated cache), and full_attention builds the K/V cache from k_proj/v_proj + k_norm + RoPE only, validated torch.equal against a genuine short reference_prefill, then runs the real HF layer on the last 256 queries against it. A prefix-consistency check would be a tautology - the first outputs of a causal prefill do not depend on the later 250k tokens - and is deliberately not used.
largest_context_tested.scale_note: PCC is scale-invariant and both SDPA defects this layer works around are pure scale errors, so test_full_advertised_context also asserts the best-fit scale of the device output onto the HF reference inside SCALE_TOLERANCE = (0.98, 1.02).

single_shot_reference_limit.reason: cost of a whole-prompt HF forward on the host, not a device limit; beyond these lengths the reference is built segmentally / by projection only

decode_context_tested_against_hf_referen.shorter_decode_coverage: test_decode_pcc prefills 17 / 2048 / 2049 / 5000 and decodes 4 steps from each; min PCC 0.999211

upstream_defects_affecting_long_context.note: Neither reduces the advertised capability; both are characterised with model-free reproducers and both are recorded here because they are what the long-context numbers above are bounded by.

prefill_sdpa_merge_scale.symptom: the softmax denominator loses a little on every k-chunk merge, one-sidedly, so the normalised output comes out uniformly too large. PCC on the op output cannot see a pure scale; the layer's residual and o_proj expose it.
prefill_sdpa_merge_scale.measured: device/float32-golden scale 1.091 at 262144 keys in 512 merges, 1.204 in 1024 merges (synthetic worst case: random Q/K/V give a maximally flat softmax)
prefill_sdpa_merge_scale.mitigation: SDPA_MAX_K_CHUNKS = 512 caps the merge count; 512 is also the floor, being the largest k chunk that fits L1 at head_dim 256
prefill_sdpa_merge_scale.layer_level_effect: full_attention full-context prefill tail PCC 0.998031, above the 0.995 bar

decode_sdpa.symptom_before: 37.7x output scale at position 262143 with the default program config; with an explicit config the cross-core tree reduction is correct only when num_k_chunks == 1 or num_k_chunks % (2 * cores_per_head) == 0, and num_k_chunks = ceil((cur_pos+1)/k_chunk) is a runtime quantity while the config is compile-time. Violations are catastrophic: 3705x at position 1023, NaN at 261887.
decode_sdpa.fix: ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/transformer/sdpa_decode/device/sdpa_decode_program_factory.cpp promotes the core-local flash accumulators (running max, softmax denominator, exp_max_diff, output accumulator) to Float32 when fp32_dest_acc_en is set AND the caller explicitly requested max_cores_per_head_batch == 1; the layer pins k_chunk = 512 and max_cores_per_head_batch = 1, which also removes the tree reduction entirely.
decode_sdpa.blast_radius: Strictly opt-in. The derived num_cores_per_head == 1 is NOT sufficient to trigger it - that value also collapses to 1 for ordinary batched decode when B * num_kv_heads >= the core grid - so the gate additionally requires the caller to have set max_cores_per_head_batch == 1 by name. Measured three ways: (1) repo-wide grep finds no caller outside this autoport passing 1; (2) the max_cores_per_head_batch=16 probe row is digit-for-digit identical before and after; (3) every non-nightly unit-test file under tests/ttnn/unit_tests/operations/sdpa/ that reaches SdpaDecodeDeviceOperation::create_descriptor - test_sdpa_decode.py, test_paged_sdpa_decode_flexible_geometry.py, test_bounded_sliding_kv_cache.py and test_mla_decode.py, 31 collected = 30 passed, 1 skipped. Neither of the latter two can trigger the gate: one passes no program_config, the other passes max_cores_per_head_batch=4.
decode_sdpa.cost: 4 active cores instead of 64 for the decode attention op - a correctness-first choice, flagged for the optimization stage
decode_sdpa.remaining_upstream_bug: the cross-core tree reduction itself is still wrong for most positions. This stage sidesteps it rather than fixing it, and records a model-free reproducer. No upstream issue was filed: filing is an outward-facing action this autonomous stage does not take, so it is handed off with the reproducer attached.

necessity_control.method: rebuilt with the .cpp change reverted, ran the same probe and the same layer test
necessity_control.conclusion: the change is load-bearing for the shipped config: stock main fails the 0.995 bar at the full context, prefill is bit-identical either way
necessity_control.layer_control_test_revision: the SHIPPED test revision, including the scale assertion; the control reproduces full_context_prefill_tail_pcc and full_context_prefill_tail_scale bit-identically and fails at the decode PCC assertion, so the layer-level stock decode SCALE is not a recorded number - the 1.29 figure is the op-level probe alpha

linear_attention_layer.note: gated-delta-net state size is independent of context length

device_capacity.conclusion: The full advertised context fits with ~18x headroom for a single layer at batch 1, so no capability reduction was made or needed at this stage.

batch_contract.prefill: single user per call by construction (chunked paged SDPA requires page-table batch == query batch, and paged_fill_cache addresses one user); batched prefill is a loop over user_id
batch_contract.batch_test: test_batched_users[32-*] with 32 unequal prompt lengths 64..3071, permuted page table
batch_contract.note: Batch 32 was tested at max_seq_len 8192, not at 262144. A batch-32 full_attention layer at 262144 would need 32 * 1.07 GB = 34.4 GB of KV cache, above the 31 GiB measured; that is a batch x context product limit for later stages to schedule, not a reduction of the advertised context, which is tested in full at batch 1.

non_aligned_length_coverage.note: pad_amount_below_one_tile is the regression range for the ttnn.pad aliasing hazard; every length listed here is asserted by a test - 735..768 by test_prefill_decode_pad_below_one_tile, which checks prefill PCC and a following decode step.

acceptance.bar_source: functional-decoder skill default; no model-specific reason to move it
acceptance.note: Scale ratios are a separate, two-sided quantity from PCC and are not folded into the PCC minimum; they exist because both SDPA defects this layer works around are pure scale errors that PCC cannot see. These fields are derived from doc/functional_decoder/pcc_evidence.json and must be regenerated with it.

fused_decoder.note: Stage 2 fuses the op graph at a fixed capability contract. FusedDecoder inherits FunctionalDecoder's constructor, max_seq_len default, paged-KV geometry and per-user linear-attention state, so nothing that sizes the context changed: same cache_dtype (bfloat16 default, bfloat8_b tested), same block_size parameter (32/64/128 tested), same max_num_blocks derivation from the padded context, same float32 conv/recurrent state, and the same 'any 1 <= seq_len <= max_seq_len, no divisibility requirement' public prefill API.

layout_and_sharding_changes_reviewed_for.decode_rms_norm: width-sharded into L1 for the duration of one op, then back to DRAM interleaved; no persistent allocation, and L1 use is 32 rows x 256 channels x 2 B = 16 KB per core on 20 cores
layout_and_sharding_changes_reviewed_for.decode_attention_heads: K/V now stay in the memory config nlp_create_qkv_heads_decode already produced instead of a sharded->interleaved->sharded round trip; strictly fewer live buffers than the functional path
layout_and_sharding_changes_reviewed_for.kv_cache: unchanged - same shape, same dtype, same paged block layout, same paged_fill_cache / paged_update_cache contract
layout_and_sharding_changes_reviewed_for.prefill_causal_conv: the FIR runs in bfloat16, which *halves* its peak activation footprint; the carried conv state stays float32 and is cut from the float32 inputs
layout_and_sharding_changes_reviewed_for.gated_norm: the [L, H*D] <-> [L, H, D] relayouts are gone, which removes a full-size temporary from the prefill peak

extra_persistent_device_bytes_per_layer.method: measured, not asserted: total DRAM bytes allocated across banks around a real from_state_dict at max_batch 32, for each implementation in turn, after a warm-up build/release of both so one-time first-use allocations land on neither.

linear_attention.what_is_added: one batch-major conv tap buffer per packed conv_state row (K of them, so the packed state stays derivable after a decode step), bfloat16 conv taps, the packed in_proj_ab weight and its bias row, the two gated-norm constant matrices and the chunk_gated_delta_rule constant tiles, minus the freed in_proj_a and in_proj_b

full_attention.what_is_added: nothing: the fused full_attention rewrites are op substitutions and memory-config choices, with no new persistent tensor

fused_decoder.capacity_conclusion: Measured +9601024 bytes on a linear_attention layer and exactly 0 on a full_attention layer, against the 31 GiB of allocatable DRAM measured in device_capacity above and the 1818230784-byte worst-case single layer at batch 1 and full context. That is 0.91 % of the smaller layer and 0.029 % of measured DRAM, so no capability reduction was made or needed. Every figure in this sentence is checked against pcc_evidence.json by tests/test_fused_decoder_docs.py::test_contract_prose_matches_the_evidence.

largest_context_tested.evidence_method: identical to the functional stage's: a segmented HF reference for linear_attention, and for full_attention a K/V cache built from k_proj/v_proj + k_norm + RoPE, validated torch.equal against a genuine short reference prefill, with the real HF layer run over the last 256 queries.
largest_context_tested.delta_against_functional: linear_attention moves by a few times 1e-5 (prefill tail 0.999882, recurrent state 0.999935, decode 0.999912, against the functional stage's 0.999947 / 0.999984 / 0.999955), all from the deliberate bfloat16 causal-conv FIR whose output feeds an op that casts to bfloat16 anyway; full_attention prefill tail is unchanged to 1e-6 and its decode moves *up*, 0.999201 -> 0.999266.

fused_decoder.non_aligned_length_coverage: unchanged and re-run against the fused graph: 1, 17, 128, 2048, 2049, 4096, 5000, 8191, 16385, 262143, the 735..768 pad-below-one-tile range, and 31 of the 32 batch-32 prompts. The fused prefill's internal chunking is a multiple of 32 (chunk_gated_delta_rule's flat path needs T % 32 == 0) but that is padding the layer owns; no divisibility requirement reaches the public API.

acceptance.precision_note: PCC and scale figures here are the measurement rounded to 6 decimal places, which is the precision this contract states them to; tests/test_fused_decoder_docs.py rounds the evidence the same way before comparing, so a re-measurement that moves a value in the 8th decimal does not make the contract wrong, and one that moves it in the 6th does.

hardware.note: two p300c boards of two Blackhole chips each

000004613192404C.state: chip 0 ARC wedged (needs an operator power cycle); chip 1 healthy

hardware.used_by_this_stage: /dev/tenstorrent/2 (TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2), a chip of the intact board

optimized_decoder.note: Stage 3 changes the precision policy, the math fidelity, the decode memory layout and the matmul program configs of stage 2's op graph. It inherits FusedDecoder's constructor, max_seq_len default, paged-KV geometry and per-user linear-attention state unchanged, so nothing that sizes the context moved: same block_size parameter, same max_num_blocks derivation from the padded context, same float32 conv/recurrent state, and the same 'any 1 <= seq_len <= max_seq_len, no divisibility requirement' public prefill API. The KV cache dtype default changed from bfloat16 to bfloat8_b, which makes the cache smaller at the same geometry, and bfloat16 remains selectable through cache_dtype.

precision_policy.name: opt-v1
precision_policy.state_left_alone: norms, the carried conv/recurrent state, chunk_gated_delta_rule and the recurrence matmuls keep stage 2's HiFi4 + float32-destination contract

decode_geometry.note: one width-shard core count for the whole decode path - residual stream, both RMS norms, every projection's activation and output, the attention epilogue and the MLP intermediate - so nothing is resharded between them. 32 is the largest value that divides the tile count of every activation width the layer carries; the legal set is computed from the real shapes by OptimizedDecoder._legal_stream_cores.

capacity.method: measured, not asserted: total DRAM bytes allocated across banks around a real from_state_dict at max_batch 32, for the fused and the optimized implementation in turn, after a warm-up build/release of both so one-time first-use allocations land on neither.
capacity.conclusion: The optimized layer is strictly smaller than the fused one at every layer kind: block-float weights and a bfloat8_b KV cache remove far more than the split gate/up weight adds - and with both phases split the packed gate/up weight is not built at all. No capability reduction was made or needed, and the advertised context is unchanged.

largest_context_tested.evidence_method: identical to stages 1 and 2: a segmented HF reference for linear_attention, and for full_attention a K/V cache built from k_proj/v_proj + k_norm + RoPE, validated torch.equal against a genuine short reference prefill, with the real HF layer run over the last 256 queries.

optimized_decoder.non_aligned_length_coverage: unchanged and re-run against the optimized graph: 1, 17, 128, 2048, 2049, 4096, 5000, 8191, 16385, 262143, the 735..768 pad-below-one-tile range, and the batch-4/16/32 prompts at 64 + 97*u. The optimized decode path adds no divisibility requirement of its own: its width-shard core count divides the *hidden* widths, which are model constants, not the sequence length.

acceptance.bar_note: The real-checkpoint tests hold the 0.995 acceptance bar. The synthetic-weight cases, which exist for shape/length/paging/aliasing/batching/trace coverage rather than for precision, hold the looser stress bar, because the shipped policy's BFP4 MLP gate/up shows a measured discrepancy between the two: the block-float weight error is the same on both tensors (0.1123 real vs 0.1112 synthetic, relative) while the real layer's output norm is 2.62x / 1.89x the synthetic layer's for the same input, so the identical noise is a proportionally larger share of the stand-in's signal. doc/optimized_decoder/logs/probe_blockfloat_distribution.log has the arithmetic and test_synthetic_bar_is_justified_by_the_real_weight_evidence pins it.

upstream_kernel_fix.what: The fused SFPU softmax correction addresses five destination-register tiles, and under float32 destination accumulation only four per half are addressable (the op's own host side sets dst_size = fp32_dest_acc_en ? 4 : 8). The fifth tile lands outside the live half and destroys a live flash statistic, which is why stage 1 found the cross-core tree reduction wrong at most positions and pinned max_cores_per_head_batch = 1. The same arithmetic unfused, under if constexpr (DST_ACCUM_MODE), never needs more than two tiles; the fused path is untouched for every other caller.
upstream_kernel_fix.effect: max_cores_per_head_batch > 1 is correct at every position: device/float32-golden scale 0.9929-1.0011 at 8 cores over stage 1's eight characterisation positions, against 0.9951-1.0168 at the pinned 1 core. The op goes 9774 us -> 2795 us at position 262143.
upstream_kernel_fix.blast_radius: device kernel, JIT-compiled, no C++ rebuild; the changed branch is reached only with fp32_dest_acc_en set. tests/ttnn/unit_tests/operations/sdpa/ decode files: 30 passed, 1 skipped, unchanged.
upstream_kernel_fix.remaining_upstream_work: the five-tile declaration in compute_common.hpp and the LLK SFPU header is the root cause and is deliberately left alone: fixing it there would change every caller of that helper. Recommended upstream follow-up, with the reproducer attached.
